items.title: Business Development Lead, Life Sciences
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Partnerships team develops external relationships that advance our research and products and expand how organizations can benefit from AI. Within life sciences, we work across pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, AI-native discovery platforms, research institutions, and experimental labs. We partner closely with Research, Product, Engineering, Safety, GTM, Legal, and Finance to turn complex scientific, technical, and commercial opportunities into durable partnerships. About the Role We are hiring a Life Sciences Partnerships Lead to shape and execute OpenAI’s global life sciences partnership strategy. You will lead high-impact research, product, and platform partnerships across the life sciences ecosystem. You will help determine where OpenAI should invest deeply with strategic partners, where we should enable a broader ecosystem, and how research, product, safety, and commercial considerations should shape our decisions. You will bring the voice of life sciences partners into OpenAI while helping internal teams turn ambiguous opportunities into clear decisions and executable plans. This role requires scientific and commercial fluency, strong judgment, and the ability to move complex partnerships from strategy through execution and measurable impact. In this role, you will: - Lead full-lifecycle strategic partnerships, from partner strategy and executive alignment through scoping, commercial negotiation, execution, and ongoing operating reviews. - Identify and prioritize opportunities across pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, AI-native discovery platforms, research institutions, and experimental labs. - Work closely with Research, Product, and Engineering to translate partner needs, scientific workflows, technical constraints, and market dynamics into product and program recommendations. - Partner with Legal, Finance, Safety, Research, and other cross-functional teams to structure partnerships with the appropriate data, deployment, governance, and commercial models. - Coordinate with Health, GTM, GSI/MSSP enablement, and cloud service provider partnership teams to turn strategic relationships into broader ecosystem adoption and measurable impact. - Build trusted relationships with senior executives, scientific leaders, and technical counterparts across the life sciences ecosystem. - Bring structure to ambiguous opportunities, clear blockers across internal and external teams, and communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly to senior leaders. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 12+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, product partnerships, business development, or general management across the life sciences and technology industries. - Bring a deep understanding of the life sciences ecosystem, including its scientific workflows, business models, incentives, and key industry dynamics. - Have led complex strategic partnerships spanning research or scientific collaboration, technical execution, commercial terms, go-to-market strategy, and long-term platform alignment. - Can engage credibly with scientific, technical, product, and business leaders and translate between their priorities. - Are an effective cross-functional leader who can drive progress through influence rather than formal authority. - Communicate clearly, think structurally, and make sound prioritization decisions in fast-moving and ambiguous environments. - Exercise exceptional judgment and integrity. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.title: Head of Business Development, LATAM
items.description: About the Role The Head of Business Development, LATAM will lead OpenAI’s regional BD strategy and execution. You will serve as the single-threaded point of contact for regional leadership across the full Business Development organization, setting priorities and coordinating the teams needed to deliver them. The scope includes growth (consumer and SMB), plugins and MCP, search, commerce, B2B marketplaces, and ads/monetization partnerships. You will identify priorities, originate and lead deals, manage key partner relationships, and work with global program owners on deals and initiatives across these areas. This is a senior, hands-on role based in São Paulo. As the first dedicated LATAM BD hire, you will personally lead complex deals, work closely with Product, Engineering, Finance and GTM/Sales, and build the team as resources become available. Success requires great judgment, product orientation, and consistent execution from negotiation through launch and ongoing performance. Key Responsibilities: - Own the LATAM BD plan. Agree on priorities with regional and country leadership, identify where partnerships can materially improve outcomes, and allocate effort across markets and programs. - Represent the full BD organization in the region. Coordinate with global functional and program leaders, establish clear ownership for each opportunity, and resolve dependencies and decisions. - Lead strategic partnerships and programs end to end: sourcing, structuring, negotiation, internal approval, launch, and expansion. - Develop consumer and business growth partnerships across distribution, product integrations, enterprise ecosystems, and marketplaces. Work with carriers, financial institutions, payments providers, and technology platforms. - Build regional platform and agent partnerships. Work with local services and global product teams on apps, plugins, feeds, and other integrations that expand what users can do with OpenAI products. - Partner with global BD leaders on regional opportunities and clear agreement on strategic value, product readiness, and responsibilities. - Set success measures and delivery plans with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Policy, and GTM. Track adoption, retained usage, revenue, and partner economics as appropriate; address launch blockers and adjust underperforming partnerships. - Build senior partner relationships and regional BD coverage. Maintain a focused pipeline, communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly, and hire and develop a small team as headcount becomes available. Qualifications: - 15+ years in business development, product partnerships, product management, engineering or related roles in technology industry. - Deep operating experience in LATAM, and an understanding of commercial, cultural, competitive, and regulatory differences across markets. - Experience in a startup or high-growth technology environment, setting priorities and delivering with limited initial resources. - Strong product judgment and technical fluency, including experience working with Product and Engineering on integration scope, feasibility, and roadmap tradeoffs. - Strong negotiation and commercial judgment, with experience structuring incentives, assessing economics, and declining deals that do not meet strategic or financial requirements. - Credibility with senior executives and the ability to lead across functions, countries, and time zones without relying on direct reporting authority. - Strong analytical and communication skills: clear business cases, explicit tradeoffs, concise writing, and disciplined measurement of partnership performance. - A collaborative, low-ego working style, with personal accountability, adaptability, and reliable follow-through. - Fluent in English, Portuguese and Spanish. items.title: Sales Director, Payments
items.description: Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide. Welcome to Fireblocks , the industry-leading digital asset infrastructure technology company responsible for 15% of all crypto transactions! Here’s the bit about us: Fireblocks is the world’s most trusted digital asset infrastructure company, empowering organizations of all sizes to build, manage and grow their business on the blockchain. With the industry’s most scalable and secure platform, we streamline stablecoin payments, settlement, custody, tokenization, trading, accounting operations, and compliance reporting- enabling everything from institutional finance to consumer-facing digital experiences across the largest ecosystem of banks, payment providers, stablecoin issuers, exchanges and custodians. Thousands of organizations - including Worldpay, BNY, Galaxy, and Revolut - trust Fireblocks to secure more than $14 trillion in digital asset transactions across 150+ blockchains. Learn more at fireblocks.com . We're also building the infrastructure for what comes next: our Agentic Payments Suite gives PSPs and fintechs the rails to power agent-initiated payments, and Dynamic, our embedded wallet platform, is enabling AI agents to hold, manage, and transact with digital assets on their own. If you want to sell at the intersection of AI, fintech, and blockchain — not just crypto infrastructure — this is where that market is being built. Here’s the bit about the opportunity: As part of the Fireblocks’ US Enterprise sales team, you will play a meaningful role in scaling one of the fastest-growing companies in the Blockchain and Cybersecurity field. You’ll own a book of enterprise accounts across the US, working closely with Sales Engineers and Business Leaders to drive complex, high value deals. You’ll be: Consistently achieving monthly and quarterly revenue targets Selling multiple product lines into payments companies Working closely with Fireblocks BDRs, Business Solutions and GTM Team Building and maintaining relationships with prospects and customers Prospecting, territory, and account planning Updating and maintaining the Fireblocks CRM Requirements: Experience selling within the Financial Services industry to line-of-business executives 8+ years of enterprise SaaS or institutional sales experience, with a track record selling into payments companies, PSPs, card networks, or fintech infrastructure providers Working knowledge of payments infrastructure, settlement, treasury operations, cross-border payments, stablecoins, or money movement rails Strong technical baseline understanding of modern SaaS application architectures, including APIs, and distributed applications Proven track record of selling into CIO, CTO, architecture, and platform engineering and shared services teams Ability to co-sell and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles alongside core account teams. A proven record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in highly competitive markets. Ability to translate complex technical platform capabilities into tangible business value for both executives and developers. We have a comprehensive onboarding and training program for all new employees. We are looking for A players who want to work with the best. Track record of success and closing complex deals within the financial services or fintech sectors. For employees hired to work remotely from New York, or from our NYC HQ, Fireblocks is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role.This range is specific to New York City, and takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are reviewed when making a hiring decision, such as years of experience, skills, and other business needs. The annual US base salary range for this role is $280,000 - $390,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several levels at Fireblocks and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate's experience, qualifications, and location. Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms. Please see our candidate privacy policy here .

items.title: Senior Casino Account Manager
items.location_text: Tas-Sliema, Malta, MT; Sofia, Bulgaria, BG; London, GB
items.description: EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people . With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. We are looking for a skilled and highly driven Senior Casino Account Manager on Malta! About the job: In this role, you will be responsible for managing and growing strategic operator relationships, ensuring clients maximize the value of our casino portfolio while driving revenue growth, retention, and long-term partnerships. You will work closely with operators to develop commercial strategies, optimize game performance, coordinate successful game launches, and identify new business opportunities. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Integrations, Compliance, Legal, Vendor Management teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with a strong background in iGaming, outstanding relationship management skills, and a passion for delivering measurable business results. Key Responsibilities: Manage a portfolio of strategic casino operator accounts, acting as the primary commercial point of contact. Build and maintain long-term relationships with key stakeholders across client organizations. Develop account strategies to drive revenue growth, player engagement, and market expansion. Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities across the casino product portfolio (Engage Suite Products and 3rd party Casino Products). Monitor account performance using commercial and operational KPIs, providing data-driven recommendations to improve results. Coordinate the successful launch of new games, promotional campaigns, and product features. Conduct regular business reviews with clients, presenting performance insights and strategic vendor recommendations. Resolve commercial and operational issues proactively while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction. Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and regulatory developments to identify new opportunities. Represent the company at industry conferences, client meetings, and networking events when required. Mentor junior account managers and contribute to best practices within the Casino Commercial team. Requirements: Essential 5+ years of experience in Account Management, Commercial Management, within the iGaming industry. Strong understanding of online casino products, game content, player behavior, and operator business models. Proven track record of managing high-value B2B accounts and delivering commercial growth. Excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Strong commercial acumen with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into business opportunities. Experience working with commercial reporting tools. Strong communication and presentation skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, international environment. Willingness to travel internationally when required. Preferred Experience working for a platform provider, aggregator. Knowledge of regulated iGaming markets and compliance requirements. Experience launching casino content, promotional tools, or gamification features. Familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI. Additional European language skills are advantageous. Key Competencies : Strategic relationship management Commercial negotiation Revenue growth and account development Customer success Analytical thinking Problem solving Influencing and stakeholder management Presentation and communication Planning and organization Collaboration and teamwork Adaptability and resilience Success in this role will be measured by: Revenue growth across managed accounts. Client retention and satisfaction. Successful delivery of game launches and commercial initiatives. Growth in wallet share and cross-selling opportunities. Achievement of commercial KPIs and revenue targets. Strong internal collaboration and operational excellence. Here's what we offer: Start with a competitive number of annual leave days, increasing as you grow with us. Private Medical Subscription. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required. Access to online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and LinkedIn Learning, and a budget for external training. Gym membership. Meal allowance. Support for New Parents: 21 weeks of paid maternity leave, with the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child turns 1 year old. 4 weeks of paternity leave, plus the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child is 13 weeks old. Our office perks include parking, on-site massages, and frequent team-building activities in various locations. And did we mention our amazing office space complete with its own pool? At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.

items.title: Head of User Acquisition
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is growing fast, and user acquisition is one of the most important levers we have. This role leads the team responsible for bringing new users onto the platform through paid and owned channels, from search and social to influencer partnerships and beyond. You'll manage a small but growing team of channel specialists and work closely with product, data, and brand to build acquisition programs that actually scale. The mandate is straightforward: grow the number of people who sign up, deposit, and trade on Polymarket. That means owning the full funnel from first impression to first trade, setting channel strategy, managing budget, and holding the team accountable to results. We're not looking for someone to run campaigns on autopilot. The prediction market category is still being defined, and the person in this role will have to figure out how to explain a new kind of product to a broad audience while also finding the pockets of high-intent users who are ready to trade today. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the user acquisition strategy across paid social, paid search, influencer, referral, and emerging channels, setting priorities and allocating budget based on performance data. - Manage and develop a team of channel managers, running weekly reviews, setting clear goals, and making sure work is moving at the right pace and quality. - Build and maintain a testing roadmap across creative, audience, landing page, and offer variables, turning experiment results into durable channel improvements. - Partner with the data team to define acquisition metrics, build reporting infrastructure, and make sure the team is making decisions based on accurate attribution. - Work with brand and creative to produce ad content that explains Polymarket clearly and converts, giving specific, actionable feedback on what is and isn't working. - Identify and develop non-traditional acquisition channels suited to Polymarket's regulatory environment and user base, including media partnerships, community programs, and event-based activations. - Report acquisition performance to leadership on a regular cadence, translating channel data into clear business implications and concrete next steps. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 10 or more years of experience in user acquisition or performance marketing, with at least 2 years managing a team directly. - Demonstrated track record of scaling paid acquisition programs with measurable CAC and LTV outcomes, not just impressions or clicks. - Deep hands-on experience with at least two of the following categories: Paid social, paid search, and programmatic advertising. - Strong analytical skills, including comfort with SQL or working closely with analysts to pull and interpret data without waiting on others. - Experience marketing a financial product, consumer app, or other category where trust and explanation are part of the conversion challenge. - Clear, direct communication style. You can write a tight brief, run a productive review meeting, and tell leadership something they don't want to hear. - (Plus) Experience in crypto, fintech, or another regulated consumer category where standard ad channels have restrictions. - (Plus) Familiarity with prediction markets, sports betting, or other probability-based products and their user bases. - (Plus) Experience building an acquisition function from an early stage, including standing up tooling, attribution models, and team processes. BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $250,000 to $280,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

items.description: Kick-start your career in the online gaming world and experience the very latest in technology and innovation. Who we are We’re part of Super Group, the NYSE-listed digital gaming company behind some of the world’s leading Sports and iGaming brands. An innovative Digital Marketing Agency based in London, UK. Who we’re looking for We’re on a thrilling journey of growth and innovation, and we need passionate, driven individuals to join us. At Red Interactive, every day is action-packed, and we expect you to bring your A-game. In return, you’ll find a supportive environment where your skills can flourish and your career can soar. Ready to become a gamechanger? Supercharge your career with us and be part of something extraordinary. Why we need you We’re on a mission to create extraordinary experiences for our customers, and we believe that your unique skills, passion and superdrive will help us achieve our vision. Supergroup is seeking a highly analytical and commercially driven Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid search performance across the Betway UK Sports vertical. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and optimising large-scale PPC campaigns (primarily Google Ads & Microsoft Ads) to drive customer acquisition, revenue growth, and strong ROI within a highly competitive and regulated industry. What you’ll be doing Campaign Strategy & Execution Own end-to-end management of PPC campaigns across: Google Search, Performance Max Google App campaigns (UAC) YouTube Reach, View and Demand Gen Campaigns Microsoft Ads (Bing) Develop and execute acquisition strategies tailored to UK Sports betting events (e.g. Premier League, Cheltenham, Euros/World Cup) Build and maintain robust account to the UK market team Present performance updates and strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders Manage relationships with external platforms (Google, Microsoft reps) This list covers your core Along with the below behavioural competencies, these are essential for all employees in order for you to embed in and drive our culture forward. These competencies are: Adaptability Ownership and accountability Initiating action Resilience Team orientation Integrity Innovation What you’ll get back We offer a great variety of personal and professional benefits to help you thrive at Red Interactive and Super Group. This includes: We’re dedicated to your supergrowth. Your hard work and achievements won’t go unnoticed. Our innovative Performance Tool ensures you receive regular, constructive feedback, helping you to continuously improve and reach your full potential. Vitality Health Care Unum Dental Life Assurance & Income Protection Tusker car scheme Cycle to Work Retail discounts Be part of that Superclass feeling. At Super Group, diversity is part of our DNA. items.title: B2B Ecosystem Lead, Business Development
items.description: About the Team: We are a small and fast-moving B2B partnerships team that shapes and executes OpenAI’s most important collaborations. We develop strategic and product partnerships across the B2B ecosystem, bringing together OpenAI’s capabilities and partners’ technology, expertise, data, workflows, and customer relationships. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Sales, we turn these opportunities into useful offerings and new ways for businesses to adopt and benefit from OpenAI. About the Role: As a B2B Ecosystem Lead, you will identify, develop, and execute strategic and product partnerships across B2B segments. This is a hands-on individual contributor role spanning opportunity assessment, partnership design, commercial negotiation, and execution. You will own the partner work behind product initiatives, from defining partner needs through launch and sustained adoption at scale. These may include Sign in with ChatGPT and industry-specific offerings. You bring a generalist’s ability to connect product priorities with partner capabilities, build a business case, and align teams around a practical path forward. You will remain accountable after signing and launch, including for selected high-touch strategic partnerships. Key Responsibilities: - Identify strategic and product partnership opportunities across B2B segments; translate product priorities and customer needs into partner plans, joint value propositions, and a focused set of prospective partners. - Own the partner work stream for assigned product initiatives, aligning requirements, commitments, milestones, and ongoing responsibilities with Product, Engineering, and partner teams. - Develop business cases and negotiate product and commercial partnerships with Legal, Finance, and Product, including selected high-touch strategic deals in coordination with other partnership owners. - Take partner initiatives from pilot through launch and scale, defining readiness criteria, coordinating integrations, and expanding successful offerings to more partners and business customers. - Work with Sales and partner teams on target accounts, referrals, joint selling, and customer introductions, with clear responsibilities for follow-up and opportunity tracking. - Coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Security, Policy, and Operations to resolve launch and adoption barriers, with clear ownership and handoffs into ongoing partner programs. - Maintain partner relationships after launch and bring customer feedback, integration gaps, and adoption barriers back to Product and Engineering; help turn early implementations into repeatable offerings. - Define success measures with product and go-to-market teams, track activation, sustained usage, customer outcomes, and commercial impact, and drive follow-up when an initiative falls short. Qualifications: - 8+ years of experience in business development, strategic or product partnerships, or related roles developing commercial opportunities in technology or other B2B businesses. - Experience developing B2B partnerships and taking a product, integration, or partner initiative from concept or pilot through launch and sustained adoption, working closely with product and technical teams. - A broad business perspective and the ability to learn unfamiliar industries, evaluate partner capabilities and strategic fit, and turn an ambiguous opportunity into a clear business case and partnership plan. - Understanding of how businesses use software, data, and services, and how product integrations, distribution, and complementary capabilities create value. Experience across B2B sectors and business models is a plus. - Strong commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to assess economics, prioritize competing opportunities, and use performance data to guide decisions. - Ability to build relationships with partner practitioners and leaders, work effectively across technical and business teams, and move projects forward without formal authority. - Clear writing and communication, curiosity about AI, and a willingness to do the detailed work of growing partnerships. items.title: Mobile User Acquisition Manager
items.description: ABOUT MEDIALICIOUS At Medialicious, we're a global growth marketing partner powering the expansion of fast-growing social gaming brands. Headquartered in Gibraltar, our mission is simple: to be the industry leader through deep domain expertise, constant innovation, and strategic scale. THE ROLE We are looking for a Mobile User Acquisition Manager to own hands-on acquisition performance across our portfolio of skill gaming and social gaming apps. Reporting to the Head of Mobile, you will turn the mobile growth strategy into scaled, profitable install and player acquisition across UA networks and app DSPs You will manage significant budgets, work closely with creative, BI, product and other acquisition teams, and use cohort, LTV and ROAS data to decide where capital goes next. You will bring direct experience acquiring players for skill gaming apps, and the judgement to scale them efficiently. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING - You'll plan, launch and optimise app install campaigns across UA networks and app DSPs — AppLovin, Unity Ads, ironSource, Moloco, Liftoff and more — chasing quality players, not just cheap installs. - You'll turn the Head of Mobile's growth strategy into real channel plans, budgets and testing roadmaps, and report progress against shared mobile KPIs. - You'll live in the numbers: cohort, LTV, retention and ROAS analysis that tells you exactly when to scale, shift spend or pull the plug. - You'll work with BI and the Head of Mobile on MMP setup, attribution accuracy and incrementality testing, including SKAN and ATT. - You'll brief and iterate with creative on concepts and messaging that actually land with skill gaming audiences. - You'll partner with product, CRO and CRM to lift conversion, activation and retention — and keep every campaign inside platform and regulatory requirements. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - Proven experience acquiring players for skill gaming apps — this one is non-negotiable. - A strong track record in mobile user acquisition and app performance marketing, scaling gaming apps and managing large media budgets. - Deep hands-on experience with UA networks and app DSPs (AppLovin, Unity Ads, ironSource, Moloco, Liftoff). - Confident with AppsFlyer (essential) and similar MMPs and mobile analytics tools. - Sharp analytical skills — cohort, LTV and ROI analysis, and the ability to turn messy data into clear optimisation calls. Incrementality testing and predictive LTV are a big plus. - Clear, direct communicator who works easily across creative, product, BI and analytics, thrives on changing priorities, and holds a degree in Marketing, Business Administration or similar. iGaming or social casino experience welcome. We're small, fast and allergic to bureaucracy. You'll have real ownership from day one, direct access to decision-makers, and the freedom to build something properly good rather than sit in meetings about it. How we work: open communication in Slack (not hidden in DMs), outcomes documented in Monday.com http://Monday.com, deadlines we actually agree and keep, cameras on for calls because we like feeling connected, and communication that says it in 20 words, not 1,000. Our values are simple — PASSION and PERFORMANCE. We love the product, we want to work with the best, we hold each other accountable, we choose progress over perfectionism, and we have a strict no-arsehole policy. If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love to hear from you. EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas — nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive.

You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. items.title: Supplier Partnerships Manager - Betting Content
items.description: We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business. ABOUT US: The Marketplace is a key part of how we expand the breadth and quality of betting content available to our customers. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the supplier ecosystem, influence commercial strategy, and build partnerships that directly contribute to the growth of the platform. THE ROLE: You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the opportunity to work across commercial, product, technology, and operational teams in a genuinely international environment We’re looking for a Supplier Partnerships Manager to help grow and mature the supply side of our Marketplace - a platform that enables third-party betting content to be made available to the sports betting industry. This role sits at the intersection of commercial partnerships, supplier onboarding, and lifecycle management . You’ll identify and secure high-value suppliers, lead commercial negotiations, oversee onboarding and integration activities, and become the ongoing commercial and relationship owner for your supplier portfolio. THE CHALLENGE: Working closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Commercial teams, you’ll ensure suppliers integrate successfully, meet agreed performance standards, and deliver sustainable value to our customers and the wider Marketplace. This is a high-impact opportunity for a commercially minded partnerships professional who combines strong relationship-building skills with an understanding of technology-driven products, data, and digital platforms . Key Responsibilities: Source and develop new supplier partnerships: Identify, qualify, and engage potential suppliers aligned with Marketplace strategy, customer demand, and commercial priorities. Own the commercial process: Lead supplier discussions from initial outreach and qualification through negotiation, commercial agreement, and contract signature. Drive supplier onboarding: Coordinate due diligence, onboarding, and integration activities with Product, Engineering, Legal, and other internal stakeholders to ensure suppliers are brought live efficiently. Manage the supplier lifecycle: Build trusted, long-term relationships with suppliers, establish clear expectations, and proactively manage performance, engagement, and commercial development. Monitor performance and compliance: Track supplier performance against contractual, commercial, and SLA commitments, identifying risks and opportunities for improvement. Identify growth opportunities: Use usage, revenue, and performance data to provide suppliers with actionable insights and identify opportunities to increase adoption and commercial value. Own supplier escalations: Act as the primary commercial escalation point for supplier issues, working cross-functionally to resolve blockers and maintain strong relationships. Bring market insight: Provide Product and Commercial teams with market intelligence, competitive insights, and assessments of supplier capabilities, positioning, and relevance. Manage the supplier pipeline: Track and report on KPIs including supplier pipeline, activation, integration progress, performance, and revenue contribution. Shape supplier strategy: Contribute to the Marketplace supplier strategy, prioritisation, and roadmap, ensuring supplier investments support broader business and customer objectives. ABOUT YOU: 5–8 years of experience in partnerships, business development, supplier management, or commercial roles, ideally within B2B technology, betting, sports, media, data, or digital platforms. A proven track record of negotiating and managing high-value commercial partnerships from initial engagement through contract execution and ongoing relationship management. Strong understanding of data and content products, APIs, integrations, or digital platform ecosystems . Excellent relationship-management skills, with the ability to build credibility and trust with strategic partners and senior stakeholders. Strong commercial judgement and the ability to identify opportunities, assess trade-offs, and turn partnerships into measurable business value. Confident communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence both internal and external stakeholders. A structured, organised approach and the ability to manage multiple supplier relationships, negotiations, and onboarding processes simultaneously. An analytical mindset, with the ability to use performance and market data to evaluate suppliers and inform commercial decisions. Experience in sports data, betting content, media rights, or marketplace ecosystems is highly desirable. Comfortable operating in a cross-functional, technology-driven environment where priorities can evolve quickly. OUR OFFER: A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Engineering offices in Europe, Asia and US) Ability to shape your own workday and career via a clearly defined professional and personal development plan Opportunity to work with senior leadership, develop yourself and build your career within an inspiring and fast-growing company and digital sports environment. A vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants A company culture that promotes social aspects, sports, physical exercise and fun. Innovative and cross-team challenges like ShipIt, office sports tournaments in Darts and Table Tennis and unique beer brewing competitions. Competitive salary and benefits (e.g. retirement pension and insurance plan) Sportradar takes over the full costs of € 365.- for the Öffi-Ticket (Jahreskarte) for you OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: Initial Screening : A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. 1st Interview: 60-minute conversation with the Hiring Manager to discuss your experience and expertise. The interview will also include a problem-solving element to understand your approach to leading partnerships end-to-end. Final Interview: 45–60-minute conversation focused on your strategic thinking and cultural alignment with the organization. Final Steps: Receive final feedback while onsite visit might be requested and, if successful, an offer! We believe great products are built by great teams working closely together. While we offer flexible working hours, this role is fully office-based, as we strongly value in-person collaboration, knowledge sharing, fast decision-making, and team connection. We see working together onsite as a key driver of innovation, learning, and success. Certain exemptions may apply depending on location - your local point of contact can provide further details. The minimum monthly salary for this position is according to the Collective Bargaining Agreement. Overpayment will be considered depending on qualifications and working experience. At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!

Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team We are seeking a strategic, highly commercial and growth-driven Chief of Staff to spearhead commercial expansion and high-priority strategic initiatives in the UK market. Sitting directly alongside the UK CEO, this role bridges establishing high-value institutional partnerships with executive-level project execution. This is a high-leverage commercial and sales-focused Chief of Staff role - not an internal, project management or administration-focused role. Moving beyond traditional sales or purely operational roles, this position is designed for a strategic partner. You will act as the UK CEO’s right hand contributing to the long-term strategy, originating institutional partnerships and owning cross-functional strategic projects with the CEO end-to-end. A core element of this role is driving commercial growth alongside the UK CEO. This includes fully grasping the broader landscape, market and competitor dynamics, customer behaviour and regulatory context into actionable strategies for Group-level product and executive leadership. Your Responsibilities Strategic Business Development & Commercial Growth Market & Commercial Strategy: Act as the local market strategist, translating UK client context, competitive dynamics, and customer feedback into growth opportunities and clear requirements for leadership. Execute on this Strategy and Drive Partner Origination & Platform Growth: Lead business development initiatives to identify and execute commercial partnerships with banks, asset managers, wealth managers and myriad financial institutions across the UK. Executive Sales Support: Partner directly with the UK CEO on complex commercial partnership negotiations. Deal Structuring & Financial Modeling: Evaluate commercial frameworks, conduct quantitative modeling, and negotiate terms for strategic accounts and commercial initiatives. Strategic Operations & Cross-Functional Execution Strategic Project Management: Own and drive end-to-end execution of CEO-led strategic initiatives, ensuring cross-functional alignment across local teams and the wider Raisin Group. Executive & Board Preparation: Draft strategic presentations, business cases, and commercial proposals for the UK CEO, Boards (local and Group), and Group executive management. Product Roadmap Alignment: Collaborate with Group product and operational teams to champion UK commercial priorities and integrate required features into the product roadmap. Structured Execution: Maintain rigorous documentation, project cadences, and operational alignment across all UK strategic priorities while navigating Risk, Compliance, and Legal clearance for new commercial structures. Your Profile Qualifications & Experience A background in Investment Banking (especially FIG), M&A Advisory, Corporate Finance, Consulting or Strategic BD experience in financial services/fintech is highly desirable. Highly analytical and proactive mindset, avoiding reactive "firefighting" in favor of methodical, structured, data-backed execution and strategic planning. Commercial & Financial Rigour: Strong financial modeling, valuation, contract negotiation, and analytical skills honed in high-pressure environments. items.title: Senior Account Executive - Technology
items.location_text: San Francisco, Boston, Seattle, New York
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! SENIOR ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE - TECHNOLOGY Why this role? In this role, you will have ownership of the full sales cycle - from identifying leads to closing deals with Global 2000, large enterprises within the Technology sector. We're looking for an approachable and compelling communicator who loves working with prospects to uncover their needs and feels comfortable developing tailored value propositions around how Cohere's platform can help them achieve their business goals. You'll lay the foundation for Cohere's growth by owning your territory and collaborating with teammates across customer success, sales development, marketing, and solution architecture. You'll be the voice of the field and help our product and engineering teams prioritize the Cohere roadmap with customer-centric care. It's a highly self-directed role, so you should be someone who thrives in an unstructured and quickly evolving environment. And your opportunity for impact will be astronomical — Cohere has skies-the-limit potential, and you'll help us reach it. As an Account Executive focused on the Technology sector you will: - Focus on net-new logo acquisition via outbound activity and relationship building with key stakeholders while also bringing a strong network of key decision-maker and influencer contacts and relationships in the vertical to accelerate engagements, drive strategic partnerships and win sales opportunities - Work closely with customers and prospects as a consultative, trusted advisor who deeply understands their challenges and goals, their technology ecosystem, and will tailor solutions to drive measurable impact for their businesses - Work in close partnership with channel partners to find opportunities to scale outreach and customer satisfaction in your region - Collaborate with product and engineering teams as well as customer success on strategic motions to deliver solutions to large enterprise customers - Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives to drive top of funnel activity - Own the full sales cycle – from initial outreach through proof-of-concept, deal close, and deployment; this is not a transactional sale that you can walk away from after the contract is signed but rather requires ongoing oversight of the project to ensure success You may be a good fit if you have: - 8-12+ years of previous B2B sales experience with Global 2000, large enterprises in the Technology sector, negotiating and closing transformational multi-year (2-5 year) SaaS deals in the 7 figure range, and a track record of high performance and exceeding quota - Previous experience as a technical consultative salesperson, selling complex products, such as developer tools, API products, or AI / NLP solutions, are a plus, with a focus on applications in the Financial Services sector - Previous experience working with customers during the deployment phase of the engagement, aligning on how best to configure and customize the solution that supports success in production and builds trust to set up for expansion and growth - Previous experience working with channel partners such as cloud hyperscalers and system integrators to drive sales cycles and hit shared revenue goals - High tolerance for ambiguity - as an early sales hire, you'll have to be a self-starter, doer and a strategist who is capable of wearing many hats and doing what it takes to figure out a path to success - Curiosity - you want to go deep on NLP and become an expert on our technology while considering how to fit into a large organization's technology landscape with a focus on its applications in the Financial Services sectors - Fantastic communication skills - you are a great listener, have a knack for understanding what matters most to others, build strong relationships, can speak to the c-suite, and feel comfortable speaking to both technical and non-technical audiences in the Financial Services sector Additional Requirements: - Deep understanding of the Technology industry, including key trends, challenges, and opportunities - Ability to articulate the value of AI and NLP solutions in the context of Financial Services operations. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

Reporting to the Head of Business Process Excellence, you’ll make sure every new development is fit for the big league that is scalable, compliant, commercially strong, and fully aligned with our winning strategy. Then show us your game face – because we're looking for a Commercial Manager (m/f/x) to join the team! Your playing field Own the governance, performance, and continuous improvement of key business processes to ensure they remain scalable, compliant and aligned with business objectives across multiple regulated markets. Define and monitor process KPIs, identify opportunities to improve performance, and optimise how your processes support overall business objectives. Act as the cross-functional connector between Product, Operations, Compliance, Commercial, and other teams when introducing new initiatives or product features. Evaluate and challenge new proposals from a business perspective, ensuring they are operationally feasible, compliant, and commercially viable. Analyse the impact of new features and changes on business performance, operational processes, and customer experience. Lead cross-functional discussions, and drive stakeholder alignment to ensure successful implementation of initiatives. Assess cost, operational efficiency, and return on investment when reviewing new initiatives. Translate business needs into clear requirements and ensure business, operational, and regulatory impacts are understood before implementation. You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a related field, or bring equivalent professional experience. Experience. You bring experience in Business Operations, Commercial Operations, Business Development, or Country Management, ideally within fast-paced digital businesses. You have strong analytical capabilities and enjoy working with data to evaluate performance, identify trends, and support decision-making. Stakeholder management. You take full responsibility for initiatives and processes, ensuring they are well-governed and executed effectively. Language Skills. Our very own Tipico tower provides an open plan space with the latest technology. Events. Sponsored Charity and Team gatherings, we like to have fun together as one team and reinforce our connections. Supportive Environment . We believe in collaboration and working together as a team but we also give importance to the uniqueness of each and every one of us. Think a career at Tipico is right for you? Apply now and join our winning team. If you have any questions or comments about this role, our TA team is happy to help you! Feel free to reach out to us on our social media channels We look forward to your application!

items.title: Senior Partnerships Manager (UK)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team Join our team of Relationship Managers and become part of an impactful and dynamic environment. Our team plays a central role at Raisin, responsible for fostering partnerships with our platforms’ partner banks. As a Partnership Manager, you'll play a crucial role in driving Raisin's growth across Europe and the UK. Your primary mission is to cultivate and oversee daily interactions with Raisin's partner banks, and to lead or support managing key accounts. Beyond that, you'll spearhead the launch of new products, integration of new banks into Raisin's and our B2B partners' marketplaces, and improving their technical integration with us to ensure scalability and the growth of the banks’ assets under management and ultimately the Raisin platform. With our far-reaching impact and diverse stakeholders, we have a comprehensive view of platform-wide evolutions, and others depend on your ability to communicate these changes and their broader implications. We are ultimately accountable for owning and managing our partner banks, taking direct responsibility for the performance and reporting of those partners and bringing new savings products to the consumer market. To excel in this role, you should be adept at managing senior stakeholders, both internally and externally. We’re a high growth fintech business, so the ability to work on multiple relationships and ad-hoc projects concurrently is key. Your Responsibilities As a Senior Partnership Manager , you will serve as a commercial lead and strategic advisor for our portfolio of partner banks in the UK and Europe. Moving beyond traditional relationship management, this role requires a consultative, balance-sheet-first mindse t to help executive banking leadership solve liquidity, capital, and deposit-funding challenges using Raisin's platform technology. C-Suite Advisory & Partner Ownership: Act as the primary strategic contact for Treasury Heads, Chief Financial Officers, and C-suite banking executives, aligning Raisin's platform capabilities with their balance sheet, liquidity, and cost-of-funding objectives. Commercial Strategy & Portfolio Expansion: Proactively structure, negotiate, and execute commercial growth strategies to scale partner Assets Under Management (AUM) and launch new deposit product lines. Structured Problem-Solving & Execution: Lead complex, multi-stakeholder workstreams across internal cross-functional teams (Solutions Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Operations) to ensure seamless bank onboarding and technical integrations. Strategic Market Expansion: Drive priority commercial initiatives across the UK and EEA markets, identifying opportunities to launch adjacent financial products and expand strategic partner coverage. What Success Looks Like: Executive Positioning: Establish yourself as a trusted commercial advisor to executive leadership across your assigned bank portfolio. AUM & Portfolio Growth: Deliver measurable deposit growth by optimizing bank partner pricing, funding targets, and market positioning. Flawless Program Execution: Successfully lead complex bank integration and product launch milestones on schedule. Your Profile Education: Top-tier Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related quantitative discipline. Professional Background: 3–6+ years of experience in Management Consulting or Investment Banking (FIG background) or Strategic Partnerships within a B2B Fintech/BaaS scale-up. Financial & Commercial Acumen: Strong command of bank balance sheets, deposit mechanics, regulatory frameworks, and commercial deal structuring. Structured Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional capability to translate complex financial and technical concepts into structured executive presentations for bank leaders. Project & Stakeholder Ownership: Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-variable projects autonomously in fast-paced environments. Nice-to-Haves Direct experience with UK/EEA banking regulations (FCA, BaFin), liquidity coverage ratios (LCR), or BaaS/Open Banking infrastructure. Transaction, M&A, treasury, or advisory experience working directly with UK and European retail or commercial banks. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of £1,700 and 4 full training days per year. Always hungry? Breakfast, snacks, daily fresh fruit and drinks are at your disposal around the clock. We are hybrid working, we are in the office twice a week, giving the team the opportunity to collaborate and spend time together. Wednesday is our core day in the office. We offer 28 days + Bank Holidays of holiday a year. One day birthday leave to celebrate your birthday. We offer you a company stakeholder pension with a minimum employer contribution of 5%. The opportunity to experience our annual retreats in exciting European cities and other team building events. Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

items.description: About Us Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. About Fanatics Events Fanatics Events creates large-scale consumer festivals and live experiences that bring fans, athletes, brands and partners together. Our flagship productions include Fanatics Fest, a multi-day fan festival combining sports, collectibles, athlete appearances, content, and immersive brand experiences; and WWE World, a multi-day consumer event produced in partnership with WWE. As we continue to scale our live events business, we are seeking an Experiential Partnerships Director to lead the development and execution of complex brand partnership programs across Fanatics Events. The Role The Director of Experiential Partnerships is a senior individual contributor responsible for turning ambitious brand partnership ideas into exceptional, executable fan experiences. The role owns major partner programs from early-stage concept development through onsite execution, working across partnerships, creative and operational teams to shape solutions, support new business development, pressure-test feasibility and lead delivery once sold. The ideal candidate has personally led complex experiential programs for brands at major tentpole events and combines strategic thinking with the operator judgment to anticipate challenges, mobilize teams and move programs from idea to execution. What You'll Do Shape & Sell the Solution Support the development of pitch materials and partnership proposals, helping translate experiential concepts into clear, compelling client-facing recommendations. Lead and support partner pitches, bringing an experiential and operational point of view to new business conversations. Pressure-test concepts for feasibility, cost, timing, dependencies, and execution risk before commitments are made. Support management of the pipeline, including opportunity tracking, revenue forecasting, budgets, and financial projections. Engage the appropriate internal teams early to ensure partnership solutions are both ambitious and executable. Own the Program Own assigned partnerships from kickoff through onsite execution and post-event wrap. Translate commercial commitments and creative concepts into clear work-streams, timelines, budgets, and decision points. Drive execution across Creative, Operations, Production, Talent, Marketing, Media, Legal, Finance, agencies, and vendors. Maintain command of the overall program while holding functional experts accountable for their respective workstreams. Oversee Delivery Anticipate operational challenges and dependencies before they become critical issues. Bring clear recommendations and solutions when navigating ambiguity or changing circumstances. Maintain financial discipline across assigned programs, identifying potential scope or budget exposure early. In collaboration with Operations, manage assigned partner programs onsite, making timely decisions and resolving issues in a fast-moving live environment. Lead the Partner & Operation Serve as the primary day-to-day lead for assigned brand partners and their agencies. Set clear expectations around scope, timelines, responsibilities, and decision-making. Navigate evolving partner requests while protecting program feasibility, economics, and the overall fan experience. Build trusted relationships across partner organizations and effectively engage senior Fanatics leadership when appropriate. What We're Looking For 8–12 years of experience in experiential marketing, integrated brand experiences, live events, sponsorship activation, or related disciplines. Demonstrated experience personally leading complex experiential programs from concept development through onsite execution. Experience delivering major tentpole events and programs for blue-chip brands. Experiential agency experience strongly preferred and will be prioritized . Strong event production fluency and an understanding of how creative concepts translate into operational and financial requirements. Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous or incomplete information and turn it into a clear recommendation and actionable plan. Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional teams, agencies, and vendors without direct reporting authority. Strong client-facing communication skills, financial discipline and comfort operating independently in fast-moving environments. Willingness to travel and work onsite during major event weeks, including weekends as needed. What Success Looks Like Partnership concepts add value to the fan experience, are operationally feasible, and appropriately scoped before going to market. Partner programs move from concept through execution with clear ownership, strong financial discipline, and minimal late-stage surprises. Programs are delivered on time, on budget and at the quality expected by Fanatics and its partners. Partners and internal teams view you as a trusted leader who can turn ambitious ideas into exceptional live experiences. The salary range represents base pay only and does not include short-term or long-term incentive compensation. When determining base pay as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/ Salary Range $145,000 — $160,000 USD By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here .

items.title: Senior Account Executive, Audience & Curation
items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com THE ROLE: The Brands & Agencies organization is run as five pods, one per buyer group. Your pod, WPP , Publicis, or Omnicom is led by a VP and staffed with account executives who own the client and planning relationships. You're the technical specialist in that pod: you own the two layers the rest of the team supports but doesn't run, your H oldco's data organization and its trading desk. This is a specialist individual-contributor role, not a junior one. You’ll carry your own curation and audience revenue number, and you will be the most technical person in the room on most calls, including calls where your VP is the senior relationship owner and you are there because the questions have gotten specific. This is a heavy, hands-on sales role. You will live inside your assigned Holdco's trading desk and data organization. Working directly with trading and buying teams, and building relationships across investment, curation, and programmatic teams, to personally lead deals end-to-end. You'll work side-by-side with Ad Operations, Product, and our Insights team to translate our audience products into the solutions those buying teams need. What You'll Do Carry the curation and audience number Own and exceed an individual quota for curated-deal and audience revenue within your assigned holdco. Source, lead, and close curated deal and segment agreements with your Holdco's trading, curation, and data teams, from first conversation through commercial terms, taxonomy sign-off, and activation. Keep pipeline and forecast accurate in CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce), and know the difference between a deal that is signed and a deal that is actually spending. Report on what is live and what is stuck: deals activated, segments distributed, spend flowing through curated packages, and the specific blocker on anything that has stalled. Own the trading desk relationship Get Genius curated deal IDs and PMPs into the packages your holdco's central trading and curation unit buys from, and into the agency-level programmatic teams that draw on them. Work fluently in the platforms these teams live in: The Trade Desk, DV360, Amazon DSP, Yahoo DSP, and the major SSP and curation platforms, plus your Holdco's own proprietary planning and activation stack. Negotiate deal structure the way trading teams think about it; floor pricing, fees and take rates, scale and match-rate guarantees, tiering, and reporting SLAs and know when a curated deal is the right vehicle versus a segment license. Solve the unglamorous problems that decide whether a deal scales: deal-ID hygiene, throughput and win rates, discrepancy resolution, and the reasons a curated package underdelivers. This is a large part of the job and the part that most often decides whether a test renews. Own the data and audience relationship Get Genius segments distributed, priced, and discoverable everywhere your holdco's data teams shop: DSP data marketplaces, LiveRamp, Snowflake and other data-collaboration environments, and identity frameworks including UID2 and RampID. Map Genius audiences into your holdco's proprietary taxonomy and audience framework so a planner finds them where they already look, under names they already use. Partner with your holdco's analytics and data-science teams on clean-room work, modeling, incrementality design, and the measurement standards they use to grade audience performance. Own the answers to the five questions every data buyer asks: scale, match rate, freshness, how the audience was constructed, and proof it drove something. Make the rest of the pod dangerous Be the technical escalation for your VP and account executives. The person they pull into a call when the questions get specific, and who they can send in alone when they cannot make it. Turn what you learn at the desk and the data team into enablement the pod can use: how our audiences are built, what they cost, what they beat, and which objections have already been answered. Feed deal-level friction back to Product and Data Engineering; new audiences, refresh cadence, scale and match rates, and the gaps that keep costing deals at your holdco. Work with Ad Ops, Insights, and Marketing on case studies, benchmark reporting, and the post-campaign proof that turns a test into a renewed commitment. Share pricing precedent, objection patterns, and winning structures with the Curation & Audience Leads in the other Holdco pods, what one of you proves should shorten the path for the others. WHAT YOU’LL BRING: 4-6 years in programmatic, curation, audience data, or agency trading on the sell side, at an agency desk, or at a platform, with at least some time spent responsible for revenue rather than only for execution. Hands-on fluency in the audience supply chain: deal IDs and curation, DSP and SSP mechanics, data marketplaces and onboarding, identity and match rates, clean rooms, and CPM-versus-data-fee economics. You should be able to diagnose why a deal is not spending without asking anyone. Direct experience working with or inside a major HoldCo (WPP, Publicis, or Omnicom) you know its stack, its taxonomy, and roughly how a new data partner gets approved. Working relationships at a major holdco's trading, curation, or data teams, or a demonstrable ability to build them quickly at that layer. Ability to sell a data product on its merits to buyers who will pressure-test every claim, and to hold your own in a technical conversation with an analytics lead. Comfort making complex things simple: you can explain moment-based audience construction to a trading lead who has 11 other meetings that day, without either oversimplifying or losing them. Operating discipline: accurate forecasting, clean CRM hygiene (HubSpot or Salesforce), and reliable follow-through on the operational detail that makes deals actually spend. IT WILL BE A BONUS IF YOU: Spent time at an agency trading desk, curation platform, SSP, DSP, data provider, or identity company. Background in sports media, sports data, or fan-engagement products. Familiarity with clean-room and data-collaboration environments (Snowflake, LiveRamp, InfoSum, Amazon Marketing Cloud) and with attention or outcomes-based measurement. Experience as the technical specialist inside a pod or account team, supporting sellers who own the senior relationships. Ad ops or campaign management experience, the instinct for why a campaign underdelivers is hard to teach and valuable here. This role offers an annualized salary of $130,000 - $150,000, plus variable compensation, and includes eligibility for Genius Sports Group’s benefits plan. We enjoy an ‘office-first’ culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location. As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports. One team, being brave, driving change We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.
